title: Elephant dancing
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="26" ry="20" fill="#8ecae6"/>
    <!-- belly highlight -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="18" ry="13" fill="#bde0f0"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx="30" cy="38" r="15" fill="#8ecae6"/>
    <!-- ear -->
    <ellipse cx="38" cy="34" rx="9" ry="11" fill="#5fa8c9"/>
    <ellipse cx="38" cy="34" rx="5" ry="7" fill="#a7d8ec"/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="36" r="3" fill="#264653"/>
    <circle cx="26" cy="35" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <!-- trunk raised in dance -->
    <path d="M18 42 Q8 38 6 28 Q5 22 10 20 Q14 19 15 24 Q16 30 22 36" fill="#5fa8c9" stroke="#a7d8ec" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- trunk tip -->
    <circle cx="10" cy="20" r="3" fill="#5fa8c9"/>
    <!-- tusk -->
    <path d="M22 44 Q20 48 18 46 Q17 44 20 43 Z" fill="#fff3b0"/>
    <!-- legs dancing - front leg up -->
    <rect x="34" y="70" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#5fa8c9"/>
    <rect x="56" y="70" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#5fa8c9"/>
    <!-- back legs -->
    <rect x="42" y="68" width="8" height="20" rx="4" fill="#3d8aa6" transform="rotate(-25 46 78)"/>
    <rect x="60" y="68" width="8" height="16" rx="4" fill="#3d8aa6" transform="rotate(15 64 76)"/>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d="M76 55 Q84 50 82 42" stroke="#5fa8c9" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="41" r="3" fill="#ffb703"/>
    <!-- dancing motion lines -->
    <path d="M12 55 Q8 52 10 48" stroke="#ffb703" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M88 45 Q92 42 90 38" stroke="#ffb703" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M85 65 Q90 64 91 60" stroke="#ffb703" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- music notes -->
    <circle cx="80" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#fb8500"/>
    <rect x="82" y="20" width="1.5" height="8" fill="#fb8500"/>
    <circle cx="15" cy="60" r="2" fill="#fb8500"/>
    <rect x="16.5" y="53" width="1.5" height="7" fill="#fb8500"/>
  </g>
</svg>
